rows.label: bf04160100_0010
rows.name: Ohhh! Old man, you're that Muimui, mo?

rows.label: bf04160100_0020
rows.name:
I remember, mo! You should've said so
from the start, mo!

rows.label: bf04160100_0030
rows.name: ...I did say it, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0040
rows.name:
Oh, right. Old man, you have so little presence,
I completely forgot about you, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0050
rows.name: Tora! That's not very nice.

rows.label: bf04160100_0060
rows.name: No, no, not at all, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0070
rows.name:
Tora-san was still young back then,
so it's understandable, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0080
rows.name:
Besides, Master was so occupied with
powering up Hana that...

rows.label: bf04160100_0085
rows.name: he had no room for anything else, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0090
rows.name: My, this is... An artificial Blade, isn't it, mo?

rows.label: bf04160100_0100
rows.name:
That's right, mo. Based on the blueprints
Grandpa and Dad left behind...

rows.label: bf04160100_0110
rows.name: Tora completed it, mo!

rows.label: bf04160100_0120
rows.name: Oh, wonderful, mo...

rows.label: bf04160100_0130
rows.name:
If Professor Senzou were alive,
he'd surely be pleased, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0140
rows.name: Muimui, do you have any idea where Dad went, mo?

rows.label: bf04160100_0150
rows.name: That day, when the lab was attacked...

rows.label: bf04160100_0160
rows.name:
I was out on an errand. When I came back,
I found Professor Senzou's body, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0170
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf04160100_0180
rows.name:
But there was no sign
of Professor Tatezou.

rows.label: bf04160100_0190
rows.name: I see... Even Muimui doesn't know, mo...

rows.label: bf04160100_0200
rows.name:
Don't be disappointed, Master, mo.
I'm sure the day will come when you meet him, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0210
rows.name: Though I have absolutely no basis for that, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0220
rows.name:
Ah, everyone, you just arrived in the city,
yet I've held you up, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0230
rows.name:
There's an inn owned by an acquaintance
just up ahead, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0240
rows.name:
It's famous for its hot springs. If you'd like,
I'll put in a word so you can stay cheaply, mo.

rows.label: bf04160100_0250
rows.name: Muimui is a good guy, mo!
